messages.author: 93734343977fa8c7
messages.subject: Re: Rapache is not working
parts:
I followed these steps on the Linux machine:

tar xzvf libapreq2-2.12.tar.gz
cd libapreq2-2.12
./configure make sudo make install

tar xzvf R-2.11.1.tar.gz cd R-2.11.1
./configure --enable-R-shlib
make
sudo make install
tar xzvf rapache-1.1.9.tar.gz
cd rapache-1.1.9
./configure --with-apache2-apxs=/usr/sbin/apxs
sudo make
make install

I added this line to httpd.conf file

LoadModule R_module modules/mod_R.so

I am seeing errors in the error_log:
Fatal error: unable to open the base package

I see apached processes as defunct ([httpd] <defunct>)

any ideas what is going on? what am I missing?

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: Rapache is not working
parts:
Those are old versions of the software. Go to r-project.org and
rapache.net to download the latest releases.

Jeff
